notes: Hunting hidden treasure across an island you explore is Adventure, and specifically the Scavenger Hunt preset — find-the-collectible with a found counter is the Roblox subgenre it is named for. world-open is the preset's own shape and matches "open 3D terrain island": one contiguous surface, chests found in any order, so nothing pushes it off P0. The chests themselves are collectible-nodes, with the ornate custom models carried as their description, and alcove-secret supplies the overgrowth and fake-wall nooks that make them hidden rather than merely placed. The prompt told me to make the creative calls, so I dropped the preset's tracker-quest — a compass and a found counter are HUD, not a physical quest board — and added path-trail and landmark-focal from Exploration so the island has a movement grain and something to steer by, since the genre notes warn an island with no focal pull is a sandbox rather than an adventure, and I left it a single surface with no water body or graded relief because neither was asked for.
